name: hud_duel_ready_waits_for_the_window
description: A Ready said while my hollow has cleared and the rival's wave still runs never spends my coming window (playtest halv s1, f105004 to f105364: 'Ready 2/2' pressed while waiting, and the horn sounded the moment the rival cleared, the caretaker Ready on its window's first tick, with no window to cork in). On Undertow's own rules against the caretaker, my hollow clears wave 2 first (its creeps leak at once) while the rival's still plays it: D and N are refused before a READY goes out, with the reason ('The window opens once both waves are over'), the card's Ready greys and its tooltip says why, Space with nothing to uncork says the same, a cork key says it too and the tray shows no packs, its hovered pack saying the window opens once both waves are over. Once the rival's hollow clears, window 3 opens for both and stays open: the caretaker is Ready, I am not, so the horn waits for the countdown and my window is mine. In that window a cork whose turn comes after the horn (the countdown ends under it) is refused by the simulation (REFUSE_WRONG_PHASE) with words that say why, never a bare 'Not now'.

steps.assert: Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.duel_wave() and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 1
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 2; the rival's still plays it

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'The window opens once both waves are over'
steps.msg: D is refused with the reason

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 4).size() == readies and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.wants_ready()
steps.msg: neither D nor N sent a Ready

steps.assert: node('TooltipBody').text == 'The window opens once both waves are over.'
node('Notice').text == 'The window opens once both waves are over' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 4).size() == readies
steps.msg: Space with nothing to uncork says the same, and sends no Ready

steps.assert: node('Notice').text == 'The window opens once both waves are over' and node('DriftTray').packs_shown() == []
steps.msg: a cork key says why, and the tray shows no packs
its pack slot says when they come

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').in_window(3) and Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.sim.seat(2).ready and not Game.sim.seat(1).ready
steps.msg: window 3 open for both, and it stays open: the caretaker is Ready, I am not
the window is mine: its packs to cork, Ready asked for
a cork that went out in the window's last tick never stood: the horn came first

steps.assert: node('Notice').text != 'Not now' and node('Notice').text == 'The horn sounded before your cork went in'
